protocol: fit di_train (A), select on di_validation (V), read di_test (B) at 48 kHz, SKIP 2400, floor 1e-4 (harness.py); model-free stages read the renders

clicks.note: 192 kHz renders; click windows 0.25 s from the onset; relative differences in dB re the second named response; history: s1 after 3.5 s of silence from the file start, s2 and e2 0.5 s after a click, e1 after steps_-18dBFS_rms and 1 s of silence; same input samples in all four

gaps.note: 0.5 s digital-silence gaps of the source between sections; output RMS in the first and second 0.25 s; input level over the last 1 s of the preceding section; pad_end: 6 s of silence after markers_end, per second; after_steps: 10 ms frames from the end of steps_-18dBFS_rms to the first click of markers_end (1 s of digital silence), every 5th frame, its minimum and the regrowth after it (dB, > 0: the output grows again in silence)

multisine.note: 48 kHz cache; per level, mean over the 4 realizations of the power of (period 1 - period 3) per 10 ms frame re the mean power of period 3, averaged over the frames of each band (dB); every multisine follows 0.5 s of digital silence; synthetic devices start from 0.5 s of silence

steps.note: 48 kHz cache; power per 10 ms frame after each level step re the segment's power at 0.6-1.2 s, mean over the 21-22 steps of each kind (dB, bands up to 600 ms); release: loud to quiet (-20 dB +-2), attack: quiet to loud; 'x' is the input itself (control)

history.note: B, 10 ms windows after SKIP; current level: x over the 50 ms ending at the window's end; past level: x over the T ms before that (from V for the first windows); 5 equal-count current-level bins x terciles of past minus current level; capacity = sqrt(sum e^2 / sum y^2) per cell; contrast = louder-past tercile minus quieter-past tercile; slope: per-window residual share (dB) on current-bin dummies + past level. Frozen H5 predictions for the takes, the same H5 refitted for the synthetic devices

lpv.note: features x^k z^j, k 1..5, j 0..2, 256 taps each, ridge 1e-4 (MultiFit); z: standardized log moving RMS of x over tau (causal: past tau incl. current sample; anticausal: next tau, a non-causal control; placebo: causal level delayed by 10 s), computed on x over A+V+B contiguous (input only); fit on A, capacity on V and B (SKIP 2400, floor 1e-4); S0/S1 synthetic devices; takes 9, 13, 18, 23, 24, 38 are gate-4 excluded (presence 10)

preregistered.state_explains_part: min drop over G 2.5-10 > 0.04, placebo drop < 0.01 at every G, mean causal drop exceeds mean anticausal drop by > 0.01
preregistered.level_normalization_not_history: min drop > 0.04 but the anticausal drop is within 0.01 of the causal drop (or larger)

narx.note: features x^1..x^5 (256 taps) plus past outputs y[n-1..n-lags] (and their squares and cubes for poly3), equation-error ridge fit on A (MultiFit, ridge 1e-4); one_step_B_ORACLE uses the true past outputs of B; free run: the model fed back its own past outputs from a zero state, stopped when |q| > 100 max|y_A|; nonlinear in y (the regressors contain the target)

summary.note: drops = H5 capacity on B minus the probe's; a component of relative RMS s removed from the residual lowers the capacity by at most s (triangle inequality), so reaching the H2 threshold 0.3 needs a mechanism carrying at least H5 - 0.3 of the output RMS; multisine: max over the gain takes 2.5-10 and the three levels of RMS(period 1 - period 3) / RMS(period 3) per band (after 0.5 s of silence); steps: max |envelope deviation| (dB)
